_comment: Revision R3.1 + R3.3: full synthetic grid re-run with (i) five Margin replicates per state (random tie-breaking + shifted learner seed) as the run-to-run noise baseline and (ii) an independent evaluation set with 100 rare cases at the state's realized IR. Acquisition decisions are identical to the published campaign (same seeds); auprc on the original test set reproduces results/campaign/synthetic exactly. Cost ~130 core-hours. Run: rare-al run --config configs/eswa/rev_synthetic.json --only synthetic
